about_the_game:
Welcome to the mysterious journey of ancient Rome! This is a stimulating and intoxicating VR casual game that allows you to come to the glory of the ancient Roman era and explore magnificent buildings and beautiful scenery.

[img][/img]

This game carefully designed six fascinating ancient Roman scenes, each of which hides a precious sword. As a brave explorer, you need to set foot in each map scene to find and collect these secret treasures. When you successfully gather all the swords, you will be able to go to the arena to fight the final battle.

When you are transmitted to the magnificent competitive field scene, holding these extremely powerful weapons, you will face unprecedented challenges. Use your sword to defend the glory and start a thrilling fight with the enemy. Aiming at the weakness of the enemy and launch a fatal attack. Don't forget to pay attention to the health above your head and feel the tension of fighting in real time. Only when your opponent's life value is exhausted can you become a real hero. But once the opponent is defeated, it can only revive and fight again.

[img][/img]

In the process of looking for a long sword, you will shuttle in the magnificent scenes of ancient Rome to appreciate the glory of history and human wisdom. Observe the fine craftsmanship of the ancient courtyard, cross the broken city wall, and feel the prosperity of the great empire. These maps are not only full of historical atmosphere, but also take you in the state of immersive and moving through the amazing and realistic graphic effects.

Don't hesitate anymore! Hurry up to this gorgeous and exciting adventure and explore the magnificent journey of history and fighting! Prepare your swords and courage to welcome the endless challenges of ancient Rome! Essence

[img][/img]

Instructions:

Find the sword at the scene and grab it

Complete 6 hunting scenes to enter the fighting mode
